statement: Between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25, a single Russian missile, drone or glide-bomb attack on one Ukrainian city or town kills at least 20 people, per the death toll Ukrainian officials report as of 2026-10-28.
resolution: Ukrainian officials report 20 or more deaths from one Russian attack on one locality occurring between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25, and two of Reuters, AP, BBC carry that toll by 2026-10-28.
failure_condition: No single Russian attack on one Ukrainian locality between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25 kills 20 or more people by 2026-10-28.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
